---
title: "EUFLYNET COST Action meeting in Vienna"
date: 2026-02-10
description: "Guillermo joined the EUFLYNET network meeting on bird migration research along the European flyways."
categories: [meeting]
---

Guillermo travelled to Vienna for the meeting of the [EUFLYNET COST Action (CA22117)](https://www.cost.eu/actions/CA22117/), a European network on bird migration research across flyways.

The meeting brought together ringing schemes, tracking specialists and modellers. For us it is a natural home: our dispersal work depends on the ringing data that these networks generate and curate, and the questions about connectivity and migratory change are shared.
